technique_name: Compare and contrast a Linux system and a Windows system.
description: Linux systems are open source and can be customized to fit users' preferences, while Windows systems are mainly closed source and provide limited customization options. Linux systems also support much more powerful command line functions than Windows systems, making them preferred by experienced developers and power users.
